gebco.latest.name: GEBCO Global Grid
gebco.latest.summary: The international reference bathymetric grid covering every ocean, produced under the IHO and IOC.
gebco.latest.attribution: Imagery reproduced from the GEBCO Grid, GEBCO Compilation Group

noaa.enc.name: NOAA Electronic Navigational Charts
noaa.enc.summary: Surveyed depth contours, depth areas and spot soundings from NOAA's official electronic navigational charts. Covers coastal waters, the Great Lakes and navigable rivers — the waters NOAA charts for navigation.
noaa.enc.attribution: Nautical chart data courtesy of NOAA Office of Coast Survey

noaa.multibeam.name: NOAA Multibeam Bathymetry Mosaic
noaa.multibeam.summary: High-resolution sea-floor topography assembled from multibeam sonar surveys held by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information. Coverage follows ship tracks, so it is detailed where surveys exist and absent elsewhere.
noaa.multibeam.attribution: Multibeam bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

layers.name: Depth Contours
layers.summary: Surveyed depth contours and spot soundings from NOAA's navigational charts, on a clear background. Covers coastal waters, the Great Lakes and navigable rivers.

layers.name: Nautical Chart
layers.summary: NOAA's navigational chart with full symbology — depth areas, contours, soundings and aids to navigation. Best when zoomed out; use Depth Contours close in.

layers.name: Water Depth
layers.summary: The GEBCO global grid, colour-shaded by depth.

layers.name: Oceanic Bathymetric Shading
layers.summary: Shaded relief of the sea floor from the GEBCO global grid, showing ridges, trenches and canyons.

layers.name: Multibeam Surveys
layers.summary: High-resolution sonar surveys of the sea floor. Detailed where ships have surveyed, absent elsewhere.
